description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Shopify Products via the Admin REST API. Search-then-write per row (Shopify has no native upsert) — GET /products.json?handle=X → PUT the match or POST a new product. Fields prefixed `variant_` set variants[0].<field> instead of the top-level product body.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one Shopify product (upserted by matching on handle).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored). No downstream data — write side effect lands in Shopify.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → Shopify field name. MUST include a mapping to `handle`. Fields prefixed `variant_` set the first variant's property.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Shopify Product Upsert
